_comment: NVIDIA NIM fallback pool for subagents. OpenCode's free tier intermittently rejects ALL subagent (non-primary) requests ('free tier can only be used from within OpenCode'), so no opencode/* model is reliable for subagents. These two NVIDIA models are verified working (HTTP 200). Agents are assigned round-robin; failed models are cooled by the event hook and skipped. Per-agent overrides go under "agents".
